title: Dewi's yellow boots
text:
Dewi has new boots. They are yellow, like a banana.

Every morning, Dewi looks out of the window. The sky is blue and the sun is hot. 'No rain again,' she says, and she feels sad.

On Friday, big grey clouds come. Drip, drop, drip! Dewi puts on her yellow boots. She runs outside and jumps in a puddle. Splash! Dewi laughs and laughs.
